fusions.name: Headsman's Drop
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a falling chop that deals 28 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wedge Cleave
fusions.desc: A heavy cleave that deals 14 damage to every enemy in a cone 3.5 tiles long, knocks them back 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bladed Harness
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take goes back to the attacker, and each attacker is [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Notched Tally
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
